goal: Allow node operators to enforce encrypted BIP324 transport on clearnet peers
Prevent passive ISP snooping and cleartext leaks without disabling clearnet entirely
agreement: Strong support for letting nodes avoid plaintext clearnet leaks (mzumsande, dergoegge, sipa, laanwj)
Addressed objection over partition risks for legacy nodes by tuning peer selection (jonatack)
Withdrew concept objection after documentation clarified privacy expectations (vasild)
Addressed objection to disabling listening by dropping inbound v1 peers instead (gmaxwell)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it lets operators protect clearnet peer traffic from passive observers and packet inspection
Avoids unencrypted v1 fallback connections while preserving clearnet connectivity
